title: Log in with valid credentials and reach recipe feed
description: Verifies that a user can log in from the auth page and land on the home recipe feed.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the home recipe feed
Verify a list of recipes is displayed

title: Login attempt with unregistered email shows authentication error
description: Verifies that logging in with an unregistered email results in an authentication error state.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with unregistered_user@example.com
Fill in the password field with SomePassword123!
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible

title: Auth page loads primary login/registration form fields
description: Verifies the authentication page renders the primary inputs and allows interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with user@example.com
Fill in the password field with ExamplePass123!
Verify the email field contains user@example.com
Verify the password field contains ExamplePass123!

title: Login with empty required fields is blocked
description: Verifies that submitting the login form without required inputs shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Submit the login form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible

title: Login with invalid email format shows validation error
description: Verifies that an invalid email format is rejected before or upon submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with invalid-email-format
Fill in the password field with ExamplePass123!
Submit the login form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Successful login persists across refresh to authenticated home
description: Verifies that after a successful login, refreshing the home page keeps the user in an authenticated viewing state.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Wait for the home page to finish loading
Refresh the page
Verify the home recipe feed is displayed
Verify a list of recipes is displayed

title: Export a selected recipe to PDF (UI flow without download verification)
description: Verifies that selecting at least one recipe and triggering export initiates PDF export UI state without requiring file download validation.

steps.description: Navigate to /index.html
Wait for the recipe list to load
Select one recipe for export
Trigger export
Verify an export-in-progress indicator is visible or the export action completes without showing an error

title: Export multiple selected recipes to PDF (UI flow without download verification)
description: Verifies that selecting multiple recipes and triggering export initiates export without UI errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /index.html
Wait for the recipe list to load
Select two or more recipes for export
Trigger export
Verify the export action completes without showing an error

title: Attempt export with no recipes selected shows validation or disabled state
description: Verifies the UI prevents exporting when nothing is selected, either by disabling export or showing a validation message.

steps.description: Navigate to /index.html
Wait for the recipe list to load
Ensure no recipes are selected for export
Trigger export
Verify an export validation message is visible or the export action is not allowed

title: Deselect a previously selected recipe updates export selection state
description: Verifies that the selection state updates when a recipe is deselected prior to exporting.

steps.description: Navigate to /index.html
Wait for the recipe list to load
Select one recipe for export
Deselect the same recipe
Trigger export
Verify an export validation message is visible or the export action is not allowed

title: Export failure shows an error message (only if reproducible via UI)
description: Verifies that if the app provides a deterministic client-side way to trigger a PDF generation failure, an error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /index.html
Wait for the recipe list to load
Select one or more recipes to export
Trigger the app’s built-in option to simulate or force export failure (if present)
Verify an export error message is visible

title: Unauthenticated user is redirected to authentication from Daily Menu page
description: Verifies route protection by redirecting unauthenticated users from daily menu planning to authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /daily-menu.html
Verify the authentication page is displayed

title: Authenticated user can save a daily menu for a valid date and selection
description: Verifies end-to-end daily menu save flow after authenticating.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the authentication form
Navigate to /daily-menu.html
Select a valid date for the daily menu
Select one or more recipes for that date
Save the daily menu
Verify a save confirmation is visible

title: Saving daily menu with invalid selection shows validation error
description: Verifies that attempting to save a daily menu with an invalid selection results in a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the authentication form
Navigate to /daily-menu.html
Select a valid date for the daily menu
Attempt to save the daily menu without selecting any recipes
Verify a validation error is visible

title: Changing the menu date updates the selection context
description: Verifies that choosing a different date changes the menu planning context without carrying over unintended selections.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the authentication form
Navigate to /daily-menu.html
Select a valid date for the daily menu
Select one recipe for that date
Select a different valid date for the daily menu
Verify the menu selection list for the new date is displayed in a default or updated state

title: Admin panel requires authentication (unauthenticated access)
description: Verifies that unauthenticated users cannot access the admin panel and are redirected to authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin.html
Verify the authentication page is displayed

title: Admin user can view metrics and perform a user management action
description: Verifies that an authenticated admin can access the admin dashboard, see metrics, and complete an admin action with confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the authentication form
Navigate to /admin.html
Wait for dashboard metrics to load
Verify dashboard metrics are displayed
Perform an admin action to deactivate a user
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Non-admin authenticated user is denied access to Admin panel (if roles are supported in UI)
description: Verifies that a signed-in non-admin cannot access the admin dashboard and sees access denied or is redirected.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth.html
Fill in the email field with a non-admin username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the authentication form
Navigate to /admin.html
Verify an access denied message is visible or the user is redirected away from the admin panel

title: Edit an existing comment on a post
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can edit their own comment on a social post.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the home feed
Locate a post with an existing comment by the current user
Click the 'Edit' link on the comment
Modify the comment text in the prompt and confirm
Verify the comment text is updated in the UI
Verify a success notification is visible

title: Delete own comment on a post
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can delete their own comment from a social post.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the home feed
Locate a post with an existing comment by the current user
Click the 'Delete' link on the comment
Confirm the deletion in the browser dialog
Verify the comment is removed from the UI
Verify the comment count is decremented

title: Post owner can delete any comment on their post
description: Verifies that the author of a post can delete comments made by other users.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the home feed
Locate one of the current user's posts that has comments from others
Click the 'Delete' link on another user's comment
Confirm the deletion
Verify the comment is removed from the UI

title: Navigate to public chef profile from sidebar name click
description: Verifies that clicking the user's name in the sidebar navigates them to their own public chef profile page.

steps.description: Log in and ensure the sidebar is visible
Click on the user's display name in the sidebar
Verify the URL contains 'chef-profile.html?username='
Verify the profile page loads the current user's public feed
